bumped.rationale: Repairs a phantom pin identity: v0.13.0 exists upstream as neither a tag nor a Release, so the 21 reviewed references named a version online pin verification cannot resolve. v0.14.2 is a published Release pointing exactly at 7107b34. Reachability review of the 17-commit delta found select-runner prefer-hosted-while-free unreachable (every ci-runner job hardcodes runs-on), and the Claude review lanes unreachable (workflow_call reusables with no caller here). The only behavioral change reaching this repository is release-asset resilience in the composite lint actions: an actions/cache layer plus a widened curl retry budget.
